tool_map.name: Blocks for Buildings
tool_map.objective: Students pick solid shapes for the roof, pillars and base of a building and compare the model with the real building.
tool_map.purpose: The child picks wooden blocks for the roof, pillars and base of the buildings in the opening picture, builds the model and finds how it is like and unlike the real building.

tool_map.name: Prism or Pyramid
tool_map.objective: Students name the face shape all prisms share and the faces all pyramids share, and decide whether a cube is also a prism.
tool_map.purpose: The child taps the faces of prisms and pyramids to find the rectangle faces all prisms share and the triangle faces that meet at one point in every pyramid, and decides if a cube is also a prism.

tool_map.name: Faces, Corners and Edges
tool_map.objective: Students count the faces, edges and corners of solids, find F+V−E for each and sort solids by flat faces and straight edges.
tool_map.purpose: The child counts the faces, corners and edges of straw and clay solids, fills the F, V and E table, works out F+V−E and sorts the solids by flat faces and straight edges.

tool_map.name: Opposite Faces
tool_map.objective: Students find the face opposite a given face and the faces that share an edge with it, on a die and a coloured cube.
tool_map.purpose: The child turns a die and a coloured cube to find the face opposite a face and the faces that share an edge with it.

tool_map.name: Spot the Faces
tool_map.objective: Students mark everyday objects by their faces and corners: rectangular, triangular or curved faces, and no corners.
tool_map.purpose: The child marks everyday objects by their faces and corners: rectangular face, triangular face, curved face, no corner and the same opposite faces.

tool_map.name: Sort the Solids
tool_map.objective: Students sort solids into two circles by a rule and place a solid that fits both rules in the overlap of two circles.
tool_map.purpose: The child drags solids into two circles by a rule, such as curved or straight edges, and into overlapping circles to find the solids that belong to both sets.

tool_map.name: Build and Draw Cubes
tool_map.objective: Students build cube models, count the cubes in a tower including the hidden ones and complete cube drawings on triangular dot paper.
tool_map.purpose: The child copies cube models from unit cubes, counts the cubes in a tower layer by layer including the hidden ones, and completes cube drawings on triangular dot paper.

tool_map.name: Solid Riddles
tool_map.objective: Students pick or build the solid that fits clues about its faces, edges and corners, or about its straws and clay balls.
tool_map.purpose: The child reads clues about faces, corners and edges, and about straws and clay balls, and picks or builds the solid that fits each clue.

tool_map.name: Fold the Net
tool_map.objective: Students match nets to solids, test which nets fold into a given solid and find the solid from its net pieces.
tool_map.purpose: The child folds nets into solids, matches nets to solids, tests which nets fold into a given solid and finds the solid whose net has the given pieces.

tool_map.name: When Lines Meet
tool_map.objective: Students make an angle by meeting two lines at a point, and mark and count the angles in pictures.
tool_map.purpose: The child makes an angle by meeting two straws at a point, then marks and counts the angles in pictures and in a classroom scene.

tool_map.name: Right Angle Checker
tool_map.objective: Students make a paper right angle, use it to test the corners of shapes and objects, and draw right angles on a dot grid.
tool_map.purpose: The child folds paper into a right angle checker, uses it to test corners of shapes and objects, and draws right angles on a dot grid.

tool_map.name: Acute or Obtuse
tool_map.objective: Students tell an acute angle from an obtuse angle by comparing it with a right angle, and draw and mark both kinds.
tool_map.purpose: The child swings a line against a right angle to see if an angle is acute or obtuse, draws both kinds on a dot grid and colours angles red, green and blue.

tool_map.name: Push the Straw Shapes
tool_map.objective: Students push one side of a straw triangle and a straw rectangle and say which one keeps its shape.
tool_map.purpose: The child builds a triangle and a rectangle from straws and clay, pushes one side and sees that the triangle keeps its shape while the rectangle does not.

tool_map.name: Angles After the Push
tool_map.objective: Students push a rectangle, a square and a pentagon and say how their angles change.
tool_map.purpose: The child pushes a rectangle, a square and a pentagon and reads how the angles change: the right angles of the rectangle and square become acute and obtuse.

tool_map.name: Angles in Shapes
tool_map.objective: Students draw three- and four-sided shapes on a dot grid, count their right angles and tell shapes apart by their kinds of angles.
tool_map.purpose: The child draws three- and four-sided shapes on a dot grid, counts their right angles, compares rectangle and square with other four-sided shapes and finds a shape from its kinds of angles.

tool_map.name: Make a Circle
tool_map.objective: Students form a circle from equal straws and from marked points at the same distance from a centre.
tool_map.purpose: The child places equal straws around a centre and marks points at an equal distance from a point A to see that every point of a circle is the same distance from its centre.

tool_map.name: Fold the Circle
tool_map.objective: Students show that the folds of a circle are equal diameters through the centre and that a diameter is double the radius.
tool_map.purpose: The child folds a circle in half in different ways, sees that the creases are equal and meet at the centre, and finds that the diameter is double the radius.

tool_map.name: Find Radius and Diameter
tool_map.objective: Students draw a circle design, mark its centre, radius and diameter and compare wheels by radius and diameter.
tool_map.purpose: The child draws a compass flower, marks the centre, radius and diameter on a carpet design and compares four wheels by radius and diameter.

tool_map.name: Sides and Angles
tool_map.objective: Students sort flat shapes by their sides and their angles and find that a straight-sided shape has as many angles as sides.
tool_map.purpose: The child sorts flat shape cards by their sides and shapes by their number of angles, sees that the two counts match and draws shapes with fewer and more than five angles.

tool_map.name: Divide the Shapes
tool_map.objective: Students find the hidden shapes in a drawing and draw lines that divide a shape into smaller shapes.
tool_map.purpose: The child spots hidden shapes and draws lines to divide a triangle, a square and other shapes into smaller shapes.

tool_map.name: Spider Web Puzzles
tool_map.objective: Students count the triangles and rectangles in two webs and decide which walks can be made without using a wall twice.
tool_map.purpose: The child counts the triangles and rectangles in the two webs and traces walks that use no wall twice to find which walks are possible.

tool_map.name: Matchstick Moves
tool_map.objective: Students make, move and remove matchsticks to form a given number of triangles.
tool_map.purpose: The child makes, moves and removes matchsticks to form 2, 4 and 3 triangles.
